# Driver Checklist: macOS Live Route Readiness

**Purpose**: Validate that driver, routing, and real-time audio requirements are complete and measurable before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-05-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are microphone path proof requirements defined separately from virtual-device publication? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001/FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are speaker path proof requirements defined separately from virtual-device publication? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001/FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Are private app I/O fail-closed requirements preserved during readiness and browser validation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK004 Are self-routing rejection requirements specified for both microphone and speaker paths? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK005 Are route invalidation requirements defined for physical devices, browser target changes, Bluetooth profile changes, app heartbeat loss, and `coreaudiod` restart? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is `ready` defined in terms of both microphone and speaker evidence, not publication or partial checks? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK007 Is the distinction between `stale`, `degraded`, and `failed` route states clear enough for implementation and QA? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK008 Are Bluetooth/AirPods-class routes clearly separated from built-in/wired release-quality routes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK009 Are the 5-second fail-closed and stale-readiness thresholds measurable and traceable to success criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005/SC-008]
- [x] CHK010 Are the built-in/wired latency and leakage thresholds objectively measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003/SC-004]
- [x] CHK011 Are pass, blocked, and not accepted browser outcomes defined clearly enough to avoid false support claims? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK012 Are aggregate/multi-output device requirements or exclusion rules documented sufficiently for speaker path validation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Are `coreaudiod` restart and stale browser device ID scenarios represented in requirements? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 Are natural silence and empty-buffer cases distinguishable in requirements? [Consistency, Edge Cases]

## Notes

- These items test requirement quality, not implementation behavior.
